{{Top}}
'''Garment-fabricators''' were used in clothing stores on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] around [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]. A hand-held holo-unit was used to adjust the color, size and style of the garment prior to fabrication.
